summary: Complaints centre on unpaid sugarcane dues at the Nagal mill, input shortages and monsoon road and waterlogging damage, while the positives are largely unverified inference.

positives.english: * Sugarcane gives farmers a cash crop that they sell to nearby mills.
positives.hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की नकदी फसल है, जो पास की मिल में बिक जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found stating this as a positive. Sugarcane growers in the Deoband region are the subject of the July 2026 memorandum, which implies cane is the main cash crop.

positives.english: Farmers organise and submit memoranda to officials to press their demands.
positives.hindi: किसान संगठित होकर ज्ञापन देकर अपनी बात सरकार तक पहुँचाते हैं
positives.basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma submitted a memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023). Deoband region: Bharatiya Kisan Sangh submitted a memorandum to the UP government on 16 July 2026 (CropGPT).

positives.english: * MGNREGA work gives some rural families a few days of wages.
positives.hindi: * मनरेगा से गांव के कुछ परिवारों को काम और थोड़ी मजदूरी मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Inference: no AC-specific source found. The 2023 Saharanpur memorandum asked for farming to be linked with MGNREGA, which implies the scheme operates locally.

positives.english: * Ration and welfare schemes reach many households in the constituency.
positives.hindi: * राशन और सरकारी योजनाओं का लाभ कई परिवारों तक पहुँच रहा है
positives.basis: Inference: generic positive. No AC- or district-specific source found in this session that confirms it.

positives.english: * Nagal and Rampur are towns with shops and markets close by.
positives.hindi: * नगल और रामपुर जैसे कस्बों में दुकानें और बाजार पास में मिल जाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia AC page names Nagal, Rampur and the Rampur Maniharan NP as the main towns, but no source confirms the market situation.

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues from the Nagal Bajaj mill are still unpaid from the last season.
negatives.hindi: नगल की बजाज चीनी मिल का पिछले सीजन का गन्ना बकाया अब तक नहीं मिला
negatives.basis: Deoband region, as named in the source: CropGPT reports the Bajaj Sugar Mill at Nagal still holds unpaid cane dues from the previous crushing season. The page gives no exact amount. The memorandum was submitted on 16 July 2026. Aggregator source, not verified against Hindi press.

negatives.english: Rain makes roads break and fields waterlog, so cane is slow to reach the mill.
negatives.hindi: बारिश में सड़कें टूट जाती हैं और खेतों में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Deoband region, district-level: CropGPT says localised road degradation and waterlogging impede cane transport and raise costs during monsoon. Not specific to a named village.

negatives.english: Cooperative societies have too little urea, which hurts the standing crop.
negatives.hindi: सहकारी समितियों में यूरिया समय पर नहीं मिलता, फसल पर असर पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Deoband region, district-level: CropGPT says cooperative societies report inadequate urea supplies, creating bottlenecks for crop maintenance.

negatives.english: Nilgai and stray animals destroy the standing crop.
negatives.hindi: नीलगाय और आवारा पशु खड़ी फसल चौपट कर देते हैं
negatives.basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma's memorandum to the DM demanded protection of crops from stray animals and nilgai. Article is dated 7 Jan 2023, older than the preferred 2024-2026 window.

negatives.english: * Farmers want free electricity for irrigation because power is costly for them.
negatives.hindi: * सिंचाई के लिए किसानों को मुफ्त बिजली चाहिए, महंगी बिजली से परेशानी है
negatives.basis: Inference: the 2023 Saharanpur district memorandum demanded free electricity for farmers, so the demand is sourced. The claim that power is costly or cut in this AC is not verified.

notes: Identity (AC No. 6, Rampur Maniharan, SC, Saharanpur) confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page; check against the ECI delimitation list before publishing. Search budget ran out after about 6 web searches and 4 fetches, so local Hindi coverage (Amar Ujala Saharanpur, Dainik Jagran, Hindustan, Navbharat Times, Patrika) was not reached. All 5 positives are inference, marked with *. Negatives 1-3 rely on a secondary aggregator (CropGPT) for a July 2026 Deoband-region memorandum; verify the Nagal mill dues and the urea and road claims in Hindi press before use. Negative 4 is district-level and from 2023. The ETV Bharat 'Rampur landslide' result is about Rampur in Himachal Pradesh and was excluded. Inference items (positives 1, 3, 4, 5 and negative 5) carry the * prefix on the English and Hindi text, as the brief requires.Field check: Nagal mill dues, Nagal and Rampur road condition, urea availability at Nagal cooperative society, and nilgai damage.
